name: Dave Seeley
description: 🎨 Dave Seeley is a Boston-based figure painter known for his ethereal realism and expressive depictions of the human form. With dual degrees in architecture and fine art from Rice University, he began his career as a lead architect before transitioning into visual art. His work blends classical technique with pop culture, mythology, and surreal elements, often exploring the spiritual and elemental connection between humans and their environment. He’s collaborated with major names like Lucasfilm, Marvel, Sony, and Disney, and his art has been featured in exhibitions worldwide, including the IX Imaginative Realism show. His monograph, The Art of Dave Seeley , showcases over 200 pieces spanning science fiction, fantasy, and fine art. IMPORTANT NOTE : This model is a tribute to the artist and not an attempt to copy or reproduce his works. Flux1.D is unable to reproduce a graphic universe on which it was trained, the goal is solely to expand Flux's pictorial capabilities.
